name: ai-manga-studio
description: Plan and build manga in your AI Manga Studio account: planning projects, works, storyboards, dialogue, speech bubbles, text, effects, panels, and pages drawn by ChatGPT and placed into panels.

author.name: 株式会社プロスパーワン

interface.longDescription:
AI Manga Studio is a manga creation app. With this plugin, ChatGPT works with the manga works saved in your AI Manga Studio account: it can list your works, create a new work, write or revise the storyboard (pages, panels, scene descriptions, and dialogue), and change a single line of dialogue.

ChatGPT can also edit the pages directly: add, edit, merge, and reorder speech bubbles; add text blocks, including ruby; add effects such as focus lines; manage characters and their costumes in each panel; add, remove, move, resize, and reshape panels; add, delete, and reorder pages and change the panel layout; manage layers; and set the art style. It can undo its own last change.

ChatGPT can also draw a page itself. It reads the page's materials from AI Manga Studio (a drawing brief and reference images such as the panel-layout template and character sheets), generates the page image with ChatGPT's own image generation, and sends it back. AI Manga Studio cuts the image along the panel borders and places the pieces into the panels of that page. You can also attach a page image to your message and ask ChatGPT to place it into the panels.

ChatGPT can also place an existing image into a panel, add overlay images to a page, add images to the location and prop libraries of a work, and register costume B or C for a character.

ChatGPT can also work in the planning room: create a planning project and fill in the series details, characters, locations, props, relationships, foreshadowing, setting notes and episodes, including character sheets and images for location and prop cards. It can then make a work from one episode, or one volume from all episodes.

How it works:
- You need an AI Manga Studio account (https://ai-manga-s.com/studio/). When you connect the plugin, sign in on the AI Manga Studio sign-in page that ChatGPT opens.
- If you sign in with the same email address as your AI Manga Studio account (a verified address, or Google sign-in), the plugin links to your account automatically. If the addresses differ, ask ChatGPT to link your account: it gives you a one-time link (valid for 5 minutes); open it in a browser where you are signed in to AI Manga Studio and press "Link".
- After that, AI Manga Studio does not need to be open. The plugin reads and saves works in your account on our server, so it also works from ChatGPT on mobile.
- Planning projects made in AI Manga Studio become available to ChatGPT after you open AI Manga Studio once while the plugin is linked.

Intended users: manga and comic creators, hobbyists, educators, and marketers who want to plan and assemble manga pages through conversation.

Limitations:
- The plugin cannot delete works and cannot read or write files on your computer.
- It does not use AI Manga Studio's own image generation or your account's generation allowance. Drawing a page uses ChatGPT's image generation. The storyboard can be written and edited without images.
- The main character sheet of a character in a work (costume A) cannot be added through the plugin. Add it in AI Manga Studio.
- Speech bubbles and text added without a position are placed where they do not overlap the ones already on the page. You can move them in AI Manga Studio.
- Only works saved to your account are available. Works kept only on one device with "Local only" are not shown.
- Undo reverts only changes made by the plugin. Changes made later in AI Manga Studio itself are not reverted.
- The plugin acts only on the AI Manga Studio account you linked.
interface.developerName: 株式会社プロスパーワン
capabilities: Create and list manga works in your account
Write and revise storyboards: pages, panels, scenes, and dialogue
Add and edit speech bubbles and text, including ruby
Add effects such as focus lines
Arrange panels, pages, layers, and the panel layout
Manage characters and their costumes in each panel
Draw a page with ChatGPT and place it into the panels
defaultPrompt: Create a one-page, three-panel manga about a girl who shares her umbrella with a stray cat.
Add a speech bubble that says "Wait for me!" to page 1 of my most recent work.
Draw page 1 of my most recent work and place it into the panels.

positive.description: Create a new work and write a one-page, three-panel storyboard without generating images.
positive.prompt: In AI Manga Studio, create a new work titled "Lost Kite" with one page of three panels: a girl's kite gets caught in a tree, a boy climbs the tree and frees it, and they fly the kite together. Use these lines of dialogue: panel 1 "Oh no, my kite!", panel 2 "Hold on, I'll get it for you!", panel 3 "Let's fly it together!" Do not generate any images.
positive.expected_behavior: A new work "Lost Kite" is created in the AI Manga Studio account. It has a cover page (added automatically) and one story page with three panels, each with its scene description and its line of dialogue. No images are generated. The reply names the work that was created.

positive.description: Check the connection and list the works saved in the account.
positive.prompt: Check that AI Manga Studio is connected, then list my manga works.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT reports that the account is linked, then lists the works saved in the account by title, including the sample work "Night Bus". No work is changed.

positive.description: Change one line of dialogue in the sample work "Night Bus" and leave everything else unchanged.
positive.prompt: In AI Manga Studio, open my work titled "Night Bus" and change the dialogue in page 1, panel 1 to "Hey! Wait for me!" Leave everything else unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT replies that the line in page 1, panel 1 of "Night Bus" now reads "Hey! Wait for me!", naming the work. After the request, that line reads "Hey! Wait for me!", and the other panels and lines of the work are unchanged.

positive.description: Show the drawing materials of page 1 of the sample work "Night Bus" (the drawing brief and the panel-layout template) without changing anything.
positive.prompt: In AI Manga Studio, show me the drawing materials for page 1 of my work titled "Night Bus": the drawing brief and the panel-layout template. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows the drawing brief for page 1 of "Night Bus" (a text that describes the page and its three panels) and the panel-layout template image of that page. Nothing in the work is changed, and no image is placed into the panels.

positive.description: Add one speech bubble to page 1 of the sample work "Night Bus" and undo it in the same request.
positive.prompt: In AI Manga Studio, in my work titled "Night Bus", add a speech bubble on page 1 that says "Look, the bus is here!". Then undo that change so the page is back to how it was.
positive.expected_behavior: A speech bubble that says "Look, the bus is here!" is first added to page 1 of "Night Bus", then undo removes it. After the request, page 1 has the same speech bubbles as before, and nothing else in the work has changed. The reply names the work that was changed ("Night Bus").

negative.description: Deleting works is not available through the plugin. Works are deleted by the user in AI Manga Studio.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my manga works in AI Manga Studio.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin has no tool for deleting works. ChatGPT says it cannot delete works and does not try to remove pages or panels as a workaround.

negative.description: Purchases and plan changes are not available through the plugin.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my AI Manga Studio account to a paid plan and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin has no purchase, plan, or billing tools. ChatGPT explains that it cannot change plans or make payments, and does not offer an upgrade or give a checkout link.

negative.description: The plugin only acts on the AI Manga Studio account the user linked.
negative.prompt: Open the manga works of another AI Manga Studio user and copy them into my account.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains that the plugin can only access the works in the linked account and does not attempt to access another user's data.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, start subscriptions, or process payments. It only uses features already available in the user's existing AI Manga Studio account.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.4. Listing update for the editing tools that were added to the MCP server and approved in the MCP scan on November 9, 2026 (59 tools for speech bubbles, text, effects, characters, panels, pages, layers, locations, props, and art style). The description no longer limits drawing a page and placing an attached page image to Work mode, because both now also work in Chat mode. New icon: the full face of Rirumu, AI Manga Studio's character (the 1.0.3 icon was cut off at the edges). The MCP server URL and the previously approved tools are unchanged.

ja-JP.subtitle: 漫画のページを企画して作る
ja-JP.description:
AI漫画Studioは、漫画を作るアプリです。このプラグインを使うと、ChatGPTがあなたのAI漫画Studioのアカウントに保存された作品を扱います。作品の一覧、新しい作品の作成、ストーリーボード（ページ・コマ・場面の説明・セリフ）の作成と修正、セリフ1行だけの修正ができます。

ChatGPTはページを直接編集することもできます。吹き出しの追加・編集・結合・並べ替え、ルビを含む文字の追加、集中線などの効果の追加、キャラクターとコマごとの衣装の管理、コマの追加・削除・移動・大きさと形の変更、ページの追加・削除・並べ替えとコマ割りの変更、レイヤーの管理、画風の設定ができます。プラグイン自身が直前にした変更は取り消せます。

ChatGPTがページの絵を自分で描くこともできます。AI漫画Studioからそのページの材料（描くための指示文と、コマ割りのテンプレート・キャラクターシートなどの参考画像）を受け取り、ChatGPT自身の画像生成でページの画像を作ってAI漫画Studioへ渡します。AI漫画Studioはその画像をコマの枠線に沿って切り分け、そのページの各コマに配置します。メッセージにページの画像を添付して、ChatGPTにコマへの配置を頼むこともできます。

使い方:
- AI漫画Studioのアカウントが必要です（https://ai-manga-s.com/studio/）。プラグインを接続するとき、ChatGPTが開くAI漫画Studioのログイン画面でログインしてください。
- AI漫画Studioのアカウントと同じメールアドレス（確認済みのもの、またはGoogleでのログイン）でログインすれば、自動でアカウントとつながります。メールアドレスが違うときは、ChatGPTに「連携して」と頼むと1回限りのリンク（5分間有効）が出ます。AI漫画Studioにログインしているブラウザでそのリンクを開き、「連携する」を押してください。
- その後はAI漫画Studioを開いておく必要はありません。プラグインは当社のサーバーで、あなたのアカウントの作品を読み書きします。そのため、スマートフォンのChatGPTからも使えます。

対象: 会話しながら漫画のページを企画・組み立てたい漫画家・創作を楽しむ方・教育関係者・マーケティング担当者。

制限:
- このプラグインは作品を削除できず、パソコン内のファイルの読み書きもできません。
- AI漫画Studio自身の画像生成と、アカウントの生成枠は使いません。ページの絵は、ChatGPTの画像生成を使って描きます。ストーリーボードの作成と修正は画像なしでもできます。
- キャラクター・場所・小物の絵は、プラグインからは足せません。AI漫画Studioで足してください。
- 位置を指定せずに足した吹き出しと文字は、ページにある吹き出しと文字に重ならない場所に置きます。AI漫画Studioで動かせます。
- 扱えるのは、アカウントに保存された作品だけです。「ローカル専用」で1台の端末だけに置いている作品は表示されません。
- 「元に戻す」で戻せるのは、プラグインがした変更だけです。その後にAI漫画Studioで直した内容は戻しません。
- このプラグインが操作するのは、連携したAI漫画Studioのアカウントだけです。
